content: chrome.storage.session is in-memory (never disk), cleared when the browser session ends. Default access_level is TRUSTED_CONTEXTS (extension pages + service worker only) — content scripts and pages cannot read it unless setAccessLevel(TRUSTED_AND_UNTRUSTED_CONTEXTS) is called, which must never be done for key material. It survives service-worker restarts (that is its purpose) but state stored only in JS globals is lost every ~30s idle-kill.
